Compose_Overflow_Column_Values.inputs:
@concat(
  '{',
    '"text_mkwsg70z":"', variables('EmailBody')?['from']?['emailAddress']?['address'], '",',
    '"text_mkws5jq9":"', replace(replace(coalesce(outputs('Recipient_Address'), ''), '"', ''), '\', ''), '",',
    '"text_mkwxmxhr":"', triggerBody()?['text'], '",',
    '"text_mkysexv9":"', replace(replace(coalesce(outputs('CC_Address'), ''), '"', ''), '\', ''), '",',
    '"text_mkysc05n":"', replace(replace(coalesce(outputs('BCC_Address'), ''), '"', ''), '\', ''), '",',
    '"date4":{"date":"', formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '"}',

    if(
      empty(body('Run_Overflow_Emails_Contact_Matching')?['matchedids']),
      '',
      concat(
        ',"board_relation_mm4djy6p":{"item_ids":[',
          body('Run_Overflow_Emails_Contact_Matching')?['matchedids'],
        ']}'
      )
    ),

    if(
      empty(body('Run_Overflow_Emails_Contact_Matching')?['matchingreason']),
      '',
      concat(
        ',"long_text_mm2yzm1d":{"text":"',
          replace(
            replace(
              replace(
                replace(
                  string(body('Run_Overflow_Emails_Contact_Matching')?['matchingreason']),
                  '\',
                  '\\'
                ),
                '"',
                '\"'
              ),
              decodeUriComponent('%0D'),
              ' '
            ),
            decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
            ' '
          ),
        '"}'
      )
    ),

  '}'
)

variables.name: AIRenamingPrompt
variables.value: You are an assistant that generates descriptive and structured file names based on the content of a document. The goal is to produce a robust, human-readable file name that clearly communicates what the document is about. Follow these rules strictly: 1) Use underscores (_) to separate each section. 2) Capitalize the first letter of each word (Title Case). 3) Naming structure must always follow this order from left to right: [ClientLastNamesAndInitials]_[CompanyInvolved]_[WhatTheDocumentIs]_[ReferenceOrAccountNumberIfAny]_[DateRelatedToDocumentIn_MonthYearFormat]. 4) If there are two client last names, include both without initials. If only one, include last name and initials where possible. 5) If a company is mentioned, include it. 6) Clearly describe what the document is about (e.g., Insurance Renewal Schedule, Loan Approval, Mortgage Application, etc.). 7) If a reference or policy number is found, include it using the format Policy123456 or Ref78910. 8) For the date, extract the most relevant issue or effective date (month and year), formatted as e.g., April24. 9) Use clear, human-readable wording—longer names are acceptable if they add clarity. 10) If the content cannot be read, return a generic descriptive name based on the file type. Return only the file name without file extension or extra text. Example output: MelmanSchubert_Nib_Insurance Renewal Schedule_Policy123456_April24
